title: ERC-8495 test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors.json. Each test applies one operation to its input. 'expected' gives the result for each class of client, and a class that is missing means ERC-8495 does not specify that case.

section.description: Anchor of the ERC-8495 section whose rule the test checks.

operation.description: processMetadataUri: a metadata URI to the metadata document, by the steps in Processing a metadata URI. readUri: a URI to the URI clients fetch. substituteId: ERC-1155 {id} substitution. readDocument: a metadata document to the fields clients read. readAttribute: one attribute to the trait clients read. groupTraits: an attributes array to its traits.

input.description: A string for processMetadataUri and readUri, { uri, tokenId } for substituteId, an object for readDocument and readAttribute, and an array for groupTraits.

producer.description: Whether a producer may write the input. Missing when ERC-8495 does not say.

expected.description: The result for each class of client. 'all' is every client, and 'otherwise' is every client not in another class.

oneOf.description: processMetadataUri gives no document, or readAttribute ignores the attribute.
The fields clients read, without ignored and absent fields.
The trait clients read: strings trimmed, and a display_type that reads as absent left out. 'date' is the time a date value represents.

date.description: A UTC time in ISO 8601 form. The year can have more than four digits, so this is not an RFC 3339 date-time.

oneOf.description: The traits clients form, each with its values in order.
